name: Regular I - Slot Left - 39 Toss

QB.rule: Quick pitch to the tailback, then run the other way, to the right, like you still have it.

FB.note: You start two yards closer than he does. Be out there first.

TB.rule: Run flat behind the quarterback and catch the pitch on the run, then get outside our end and turn up. Drifting forward for it is a fumble.

coaching_points: The pitch goes early and behind him. A quarterback who waits to be tackled first will pitch it on the ground.
The fullback is two yards closer to the edge than the tailback. He has to be out there first, or there is nothing to turn up behind.
This is what the Power buys. Call it once they have started crashing our tackle, and the edge is empty.
